verdict.rationale: The published Empresa Online pages require authentication before filing: Cartão de Cidadão, Chave Móvel Digital, a professional certificate, or eIDAS. No keyless or file-number entry path is documented. Strong-ID authentication is not the same as account creation, but it is not the anonymous or reference-number entry the story asks for, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
